Sprint Planning

Sprint 24 Goals

Primary Objective: Enhance documentation user experience and add content management features

User Stories

High Priority

  1. DOC-001: Implement automatic Markdown processing

    • Story Points: 8
    • Acceptance Criteria:
      • New .md files automatically appear on website
      • Proper metadata handling
      • Automatic table of contents generation

  2. DOC-002: Add search functionality

    • Story Points: 5
    • Acceptance Criteria:
      • Full-text search across all content
      • Search results with snippets
      • Filter by category and tags

  3. DOC-003: Improve navigation and breadcrumbs

    • Story Points: 3
    • Acceptance Criteria:
      • Dynamic breadcrumb generation
      • Related content suggestions
      • Category-based navigation

Medium Priority

  1. DOC-004: Add content versioning

    • Story Points: 5
    • Acceptance Criteria:
      • Track document changes
      • Version history display
      • Rollback functionality

  2. DOC-005: Implement content approval workflow

    • Story Points: 8
    • Acceptance Criteria:
      • Draft/publish states
      • Review and approval process
      • Notification system

Sprint Capacity

  • Team Capacity: 25 story points
  • Planned Work: 29 story points
  • Risk: Slightly over capacity, may need to defer one story
